name: Themes - Awesome Pi Coding Agent
description: Named Pi profiles (modlists) for switching active tools and extension packages. Tool changes apply instantly; extension-package changes show a diff, require confirmation, update settings.json, and reload Pi resources. ... Color themes for pi: cyberpunk, nord, gruvbox, tokyo-night, catppuccin, and more.
